assertions.assertion: Registers an NpgsqlDataSource singleton from the connection string and selects PostgreSQL with AddStorage(storage => storage.AddPostgreSql())
Explains that no EF Core migrations are needed (document-based storage) but the common storage schema must still be created
assertions.rationale: Says migrations are needed if EF-based (dotnet ef), the opposite of the document-based no-EF-migrations point.

assertions.assertion: Shows IStorageInstanceSchema.MigrateAsync() resolved via IStorageInstanceSchemaFactory, and notes that in production it should run as a controlled deployment step rather than app startup
assertions.rationale: No IStorageInstanceSchema.MigrateAsync or factory; only EF migration bundle advice.
